ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a distribution of approximately 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels against a 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Densely packed high-intensity circular and elliptical blobs (rosettes) distributed across the entirety of both lobes, contrasted by a low-intensity vertical central channel emanating from the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped median notch with an approximate angle of 50 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; extreme jaggedness and irregular peaks are concentrated at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical upward sweep with a moderately concave trailing edge curvature leading to elongated, jagged tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel clusters varying in diameter, covering most of the mid-to-outer ventral surface area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; notably a cluster of three near-vertical parallel lines on the right central lobe and diagonal tracks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological scarring including hundreds of circular rosette marks and several distinct sets of linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme irregular erosion and missing segments at the far distal ends of both lobes, particularly the right-side tip which shows a deeply notched, frayed appearance.
